hazards.control: Data sheets on site; eye and skin protection at the additive unit; spill kits.

tabs.overview: Slickwater carries sand by velocity and leaves the least damage; linear and crosslinked gels carry more sand at lower rates and need breakers to clean up; hybrids pump slickwater first and gel later. Pad Setup uses the fluid choice to set friction and screenout tolerance.
tabs.engineering: Viscosity at bottomhole temperature, friction pressure, proppant transport, and break time are the design tests.
tabs.safety: Chemical handling; hot crosslinked fluids in some systems.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki fracturing fluids and additives (S50), propping agents (S51), API RP 19C (S52), API Spec 5CT (S27), API Spec 10A (S28), field practice (S9).

name: Fracturing fluid systems
function: The base fluid designs: slickwater (water plus friction reducer), high-viscosity friction reducer systems, linear polymer gels, crosslinked gels, and the less common foam, oil-based, and acid-based fluids.
